commits.message:
fix(text): RichText strips carriage returns, as Rich's Text does (rich-text-svdg) (#319)

* fix(text): RichText strips carriage returns, as Rich's Text does (rich-text-svdg)

A CR in a panel title reached the wire inside the border row and sent the
cursor back over the corner; Rich draws `a b`. The stripped set is now every
C0 control and DEL but tab and newline: Rich's STRIP_CONTROL_CODES plus the
port's extension, pinned code by code in test/core/text.test.ts.

* fix(pretty): indent guides count their offsets over the text RichText holds (rich-text-svdg)

Stripping CR moved every guide after a key or toString holding one a cell
right, onto the content. drawMargins now strips before it counts.

effects-feel: breaths, flashes and passes of light are events of their own; the step gate watches half an hour (rich-effects-fxiy.b6i)

Pulse: most breaths shallow and quick, about one in six a deep sigh, each
starting early or late in its turn. Sparkle: a firefly flashes, hovers,
fades, and flashes again a few cells off. Shimmer: a glitter path, each
pass at its own pace after a still spell of its own. A weaker event is a
shorter one (swell), so variety costs no smoothness.

The 1 fps step gate sampled 300 s; over 600 s drift and sparkle already
broke it. It now checks every second of 1800 s.
